import java.util.*;
public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, val, w;
        Edge(int to, int next, int val, int w) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.val = val;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static class FlowResult {
        int c, f;
        FlowResult() {
            this.c = 0;
            this.f = 0;
        }
    }

    static final int N = 5005;
    static final int inf = 1000000000;
    static int[] pre = new int[N];
    static int[] dis = new int[N];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];

    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int edge_id = 0;

    static int n, m, k, c, d, s, t, tot;
    static int[][] E = new int[N][2];

    static int P(int i, int j) {
        return i * n + j;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        edges.add(new Edge(v, head[u], val, w));
        head[u] = edge_id++;
    }

    static void add(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        addEdge(u, v, val, w);
        addEdge(v, u, 0, -w);
    }

    static boolean SPFA() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, 0, tot + 1, inf);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        dis[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            vis[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                int v = e.to;
                if (e.val > 0 && dis[v] > dis[u] + e.w) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + e.w;
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (!vis[v]) {
                        vis[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[t] < inf;
    }

    static FlowResult mcmf() {
        FlowResult res = new FlowResult();
        while (SPFA()) {
            int flow = inf;
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edges.get(pre[x] ^ 1).to) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, edges.get(pre[x]).val);
            }
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edges.get(pre[x] ^ 1).to) {
                edges.get(pre[x]).val -= flow;
                edges.get(pre[x] ^ 1).val += flow;
            }
            res.f += flow;
            res.c += dis[t] * flow;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        int cs = 2 * k;
        tot = cs * n;
        s = ++tot;
        t = ++tot;

        for (int i = 0; i <= tot; i++) {
            head[i] = 0;
        }
        edges.clear();
        edge_id = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            E[i][0] = sc.nextInt();
            E[i][1] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int tp = sc.nextInt();
            add(s, P(0, tp), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            // Reading edges, already done above
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= cs - 1; i++) {
            add(P(i, 1), t, k, c * i);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                add(P(i - 1, j), P(i, j), k, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int tIdx = 1; tIdx <= k; tIdx++) {
                    int from1 = P(i - 1, E[j][0]);
                    int to1 = P(i, E[j][1]);
                    add(from1, to1, 1, (2 * tIdx - 1) * d);
                    int from2 = P(i - 1, E[j][1]);
                    int to2 = P(i, E[j][0]);
                    add(from2, to2, 1, (2 * tIdx - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mcmf().c);
        sc.close();
    }
}
